function.name: create_pen
function.description: This function creates a pen object with specified style, width, and color. It allocates memory for the pen object, sets its properties, and returns a handle to the pen.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: This parameter defines the style of the pen. It can be solid, dash, dot, dashdot, dashdotdot, insideframe or null.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: This parameter defines the width of the pen. If the style is null, the width is set to 1.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: This parameter defines the color of the pen. If the style is null, the color is set to 0.

function.return_type: HPEN. It represents a handle to the created pen object. If the pen object cannot be created, the function returns 0.

function.name: NtGdiCreatePen
function.description: This function creates a logical pen that has the specified style, width, and color. If the function is called with a brush, it will output a warning as brushes are not supported.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: Defines the style of the pen

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Defines the width of the pen

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Defines the color of the pen

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: Not supported, will output a warning if not NULL

function.return_type: HPEN, represents a handle to the logical pen created by the function

function.name: NtGdiExtCreatePen
function.description: This function is used to create a logical pen that has the specified style, width, and brush attributes. The pen can subsequently be selected into a device context, to draw lines and curves.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: The pen style

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width of the pen

parameters.name: brush_style
parameters.description: The brush style

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: The color of the pen

parameters.name: client_hatch
parameters.description: The hatch of the client

parameters.name: hatch
parameters.description: The hatch of the pen

parameters.name: style_count
parameters.description: The count of the style bits

parameters.name: style_bits
parameters.description: The style bits

parameters.name: dib_size
parameters.description: The size of the device-independent bitmap

parameters.name: old_style
parameters.description: A flag indicating whether to use the old style or not

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: A handle to the brush

function.return_type: HPEN, a handle to the logical pen if the function is successful. If the function fails, the return value is NULL.

function.name: NtGdiSelectPen
function.description: This function selects a pen object into the specified device context. The new pen replaces the previous pen.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: A handle to the device context.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: A handle to the pen object.

function.return_type: HGDIOBJ, represents the handle to the pen object that was replaced in the device context.

function.name: PEN_DeleteObject
function.description: This function deletes a pen object, freeing the associated GDI handle and brush pattern before freeing the pen itself.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is a handle to the GDI object to be deleted.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the pen object was successfully deleted, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: PEN_GetObject
function.description: This function retrieves information for the specified graphics object.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Handle to the graphics object

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Specifies the number of bytes of information to be written to the buffer

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer that receives the information about the specified graphics object

function.return_type: INT, represents the number of bytes stored into the buffer
